title: Jericho
sourceLines: -1. A city east of Jerusalem and near the Jordan River Nu 22:1; 26:3; De 34:1
.Called THE CITY OF PALM TREES De 34:3
.Rahab the harlot lived in Jos 2; Heb 11:31
.Joshua sees the “captain of the host” of the Lord near Jos 5:13-15
.Besieged by Joshua for seven days; fall and destruction of Jos 6; 24:11
.Situated within the territory allotted to Benjamin Jos 18:12,21
.King of Moab makes conquest of, and establishes his capital at Jud 3:13
.Company of “the sons of the prophets,” lived at 2Ki 2:4,5,15,18
.Captives of Judah, taken by the king of Israel, released at, on account of the de- nunciation of the prophet Oded 2Ch 28:7-15
.Inhabitants of, taken captive to Babylon, return to, with Ezra and Nehemiah Ezr 2:34; Ne 7:36
.Assist in repairing the walls of Jerusalem Ne 3:2
.Blind men healed at, by Jesus Mt 20:29-34; Mr 10:46; Lu 18:35
